text: dsh-netassist 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的网络与代理诊断插件，通过注册一组 agent 可调用的工具检查 GitHub 连通性、系统代理状态、本地代理端口、hosts 文件、DNS 解析差异和 npm registry。用户可对任意主机执行 DNS、TCP 与 HTTP 状态检查，也可运行综合诊断并获得发现项和调整建议。适合排查 DSH 无法连接 GitHub 或代理未生效的情况；不需要 API 密钥，Windows 系统检查依赖 PowerShell。

dsh-netassist adds DSH tools for GitHub access, proxy settings and ports, hosts entries, DNS answers, and npm registry checks. It diagnoses hosts through DNS, TCP, and HTTP, or combines checks into findings and suggestions. No API key is needed; Windows checks use PowerShell.
帮我确认当前电脑能不能连上 GitHub。
我想查看 DSH 使用的系统代理和代理环境变量。
检查一下本机哪些常见代理端口正在监听。
让 DSH 帮我逐步排查某个主机的 DNS、TCP 和 HTTP 连通情况。
代理开着时怎么找 hosts 文件里固定的 GitHub 地址冲突？
比较几个公共 DNS 对同一个域名的解析结果。
Why can my machine reach a proxy port but still fail to open GitHub?
Can I check whether my configured npm registry is reachable?
dsh-netassist 的功能「GitHub 连通性」：检查 GitHub 域名解析、TCP 443 和 HTTPS 状态码。调用网络状态工具即可获得当前连接结果。
dsh-netassist 的功能「代理状态与端口」：读取 Windows 系统代理及代理环境变量，并探测常见或指定的本机代理 TCP 端口，返回各端口的连通状态。
dsh-netassist 的功能「主机诊断」：提交主机名、端口和路径后，依次检查 DNS 解析、TCP 连接和 HTTP 状态，帮助定位某一段连通失败。
dsh-netassist 的功能「网络医生」：一键汇总代理、代理端口、TUN、GitHub、hosts、DNS 和 npm registry 检查，按发现的问题给出具体调整建议。
dsh-netassist 的功能「DNS 与 npm 源检测」：将域名交给多个公共 DNS 服务器比较解析答案，并检测 npm 当前配置源和官方源是否可达。
dsh-netassist 使用前须知：代理状态、hosts 和 TUN 检查针对 Windows，并调用 PowerShell；非 Windows 环境的这些检查可能无法运行（见 src/checks.ts:17-76）。
dsh-netassist README · dsh-netassist：**When GitHub is unreachable or the proxy is not taking effect: one command that says which link in the chain broke, and what to change.**

dsh-netassist README · When you need this：- DSH cannot reach GitHub or npm and you do not know whether it is DNS, TCP or the proxy
- Your system proxy is configured but traffic is not going through it — TUN mode, routing rules, or a stale hosts entry
- You would rather not run ping, nslookup and tracert by hand and interpret four outputs yourself

Every conclusion carries the premise it depends on, so the report cannot contradict itself — a port is only reported as a problem when a proxy is actually configured to use it.

Born from real-world China-network pain: GitHub flaky, proxies everywhere, hosts conflicts, TUN vs system proxy confusion. This plugin gives your agent one-shot answers to "is GitHub reachable?", "what proxy is my system using?", "is my proxy port alive?", plus a full diagnosis chain — all read-only, all injection-safe.

dsh-netassist README · Platform：**Windows.** Proxy detection reads the Windows registry and the checks shell out to
`powershell.exe`. On other platforms the tools start but their checks cannot run, and they say
so (`spawn powershell.exe ENOENT`) instead of reporting a clean result.

dsh-netassist README · Timing：The Windows checks spawn a `powershell.exe`, and a cold one costs roughly 20 seconds to start; the
DNS comparison and npm registry checks use Node's own network stack and add well under a second. So
on a freshly booted Windows machine:

- the individual tools answer within about half a minute
- **`net_doctor` can exceed a minute**, because it runs six checks in parallel (system proxy, GitHub
  reachability, hosts file, TUN adapters, DNS comparison, npm registry) plus a port probe

dsh-netassist README · Timing：Most MCP clients default to a 60-second request timeout, so `net_doctor` may time out on a cold
machine even though it is working. If that happens, call the individual checks (`net_github_status`,
`net_proxy_status`, `net_hosts_check`, `net_dns_compare`, `net_registry_check`) instead, or raise
your client's request timeout. Once PowerShell has been used a few times the cost drops sharply.

dsh-netassist README · Tools：| Tool | What it answers |
|---|---|
| `net_github_status` | Is GitHub reachable right now? (DNS + TCP 443) |
| `net_proxy_status` | System proxy config: registry `ProxyEnable/ProxyServer/ProxyOverride` + proxy env vars |
| `net_proxy_probe` | Which common local proxy ports are alive? (default 10808/10809/7890/7897/8888/1080) |
| `net_diag` | Full chain for any host: DNS → TCP → HTTPS status code |
| `net_hosts_check` | GitHub entries pinned in the hosts file (proxy conflict scan) |
| `net_dns_compare` | Ask AliDNS / DNSPod / Cloudflare / Google the same question and compare — is the system resolver returning a stale address? |
| `net_registry_check` | Is the npm registry npm is configured to use actually reachable? Checks the configured one and the official one. |

dsh-netassist README · Install：Then ask your agent:
- "check if github.com is reachable" → `net_github_status`
- "what proxy is my system using?" → `net_proxy_status`
- "is my proxy running?" → `net_proxy_probe`
- "why can't I reach api.example.com:8443?" → `net_diag` host=api.example.com port=8443
- "any github entries in my hosts?" → `net_hosts_check`
- "why does github.com resolve but not work?" → `net_dns_compare` host=github.com
- "why does npm install fail?" → `net_registry_check`

dsh-netassist README · How it works：Every tool runs a short read-only PowerShell snippet through `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive`. All user input crosses the script boundary as **Base64** — injection-proof by construction. No writes, no admin rights, no dependencies.

- Config: `psTimeoutMs` (default 25000) — per-call PowerShell timeout, settable in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `netassist` entry.
- Windows-only: tools fail loudly on non-Windows platforms.

dsh-netassist README · Real-world example (this machine)：```
net_github_status → DNS: 20.205.243.166, TCP 443: OPEN
net_proxy_status  → ProxyEnable: 1, ProxyServer: 127.0.0.1:10808
net_proxy_probe   → 10808 OPEN, 10809/7890/7897/8888/1080 CLOSED
net_hosts_check   → no github entries in hosts (clean)

dsh-netassist README · Troubleshooting：- "PowerShell failed": usually execution-policy or anti-virus interference. The plugin uses `-NoProfile -NonInteractive`; check `Get-ExecutionPolicy` — it does not require RemoteSigned.
- Port probes use a 5s connect timeout each, so a full probe takes ~5-10s worst case.
